desc: Derive and document the BFS-layer counting formula: label factor C(rem,b), internal-edge factor (1+x)^{C(b,2)}, and cross-edge factor ((1+x)^a-1)^b for adding a layer of size b after a layer of size a.
Precompute binomial coefficients modulo P and transition evaluations T_{a,b}(t)=((1+t)^a-1)^b(1+t)^{C(b,2)} for all needed t and 1<=a,b<=N/2.

Build the reachable DP state graph over (used_even, used_odd, previous_layer_size, last_parity), generate transitions that add one nonempty opposite-parity layer, attach label-choice factors C(remaining,b), and order states by used vertices for topological processing.

For each evaluation point t, run the scalar DP modulo P: start from layer 0, propagate through transitions using T_{a,b}(t), and accumulate values of balanced terminal states (used_even=used_odd=N/2) to obtain F(t).
Interpolate the degree-D polynomial from F(0),...,F(L) modulo P using Newton forward differences and conversion from binomial basis to standard coefficients, then output coefficients for M=N-1..D.
Integrate stdin/stdout handling and validate against the samples and edge cases such as N=2 and trailing zero answers, ensuring all arithmetic is performed modulo P.
Optimize evaluation DP with pruning, grouped transition factors, delayed modular reduction, and reduced evaluation points using the maximum possible valid edge count.
